18:       throw new Error("Password hash cannot be empty");

22:     const bcryptRegex = /^\$2[aby]\$\d{2}\$.{53}$/;
23:     if (!bcryptRegex.test(hash)) {
24:       throw new Error("Password must be a valid bcrypt hash");
25:     }
26:   }
